tips.title: Why small deposits add up
tips.body: You don't need a big amount to make progress. A small deposit every week adds up faster than you'd expect, and each one makes the next surprise a little less stressful. Steady beats big.

tips.title: Make it automatic
tips.body: Saving works best when you don't have to remember it. Set up an automatic transfer in your bank's app, on payday or every week. Then your fund grows even on busy weeks.

tips.title: When it's the right time to use it
tips.body: Ask yourself: is this urgent, and could I have planned for it? If it's urgent and unplanned, like a repair you need to get to work, this fund is for exactly that. Using it is not a setback. You can rebuild.

tips.title: Choosing your next loaf
tips.body: Your cushion is built. Next, you can grow it to three months, pay down high-interest debt, or start learning to invest. We'll suggest one based on what you told us, and you pick.
